rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial verb for being in a steady romantic relationship.

example.english: I date them exclusively, and we’ve been together for almost three years.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 paak3 to1 faai3 saam1 nin4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a pre-arranged meeting, especially a romantic outing, rather than for the person attending it.

example.english: I have a date with my girlfriend tonight.
example.traditional: 我今晚同女朋友有個約會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 tung4 neoi5 pang4 jau5 jau5 go3 joek3 wui6

rows.note: Use this for the person accompanying someone on a social or romantic date, rather than for the outing itself.

example.traditional: 你今晚個約會對象係邊個？
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 maan5 go3 joek3 wui6 deoi3 zoeng6 hai6 bin1 go3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a calendar date or the date written on a document.

example.english: You need to fill in the date on this form.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 jiu3 tin4 faan1 jat6 kei4

rows.note: Use this for taking someone out on a date, especially when the romantic context is understood.

example.english: They often take people out on dates, but they don’t really want to date anyone.
example.traditional: 佢成日約人出街，唔係真係想拍拖。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 joek3 jan4 ceot1 gaai1 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 soeng2 paak3 to1

rows.note: Use this when a show, style, or idea becomes old-fashioned and less appealing.

example.english: This show is starting to date, so not many people want to watch it.
example.traditional: 呢套戲而家變得過時，冇乜人想睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ji4 gaa1 bin3 dak1 gwo3 si4 mou5 mat1 jan4 soeng2 tai2

rows.note: Use this transitive construction when something causes a show, style, or idea to become outdated.

example.english: Streaming platforms make videotapes date quickly.
example.traditional: 串流平台令錄影帶好快過時。
example.jyutping: cyun3 lau4 ping4 toi4 ling6 luk6 jing2 daai3 hou2 faai3 gwo3 si4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the sweet fruit of the date palm.

example.english: I bought a pack of date fruit at the supermarket.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ciu1 si5 maai5 zo2 baau1 je4 zou2
